company.name: Celestial Tours
company.mission: Seamless end-to-end trip planning, real-time weather disruption mitigation, and transparent customizable booking across India.

operational_rules.budget_enforcement: Total package cost must never exceed the traveler's stated budget ceiling.
operational_rules.chronological_sequencing: Slot 1 (Check-in/Morning baseline), Slot 2 (Chauffeur Transit Buffer), Slot 3 (Midday activity), Slot 4 (Evening experience).

weather_adaptation.disruption_action: Instantly switch outdoor/water activities to verified sheltered alternatives (spice plantations, indoor museums, cooking sessions) with zero penalty.

customized_payment_policy.mandatory_stays: Core hotel stays are pre-booked for booking guarantee.
customized_payment_policy.optional_rides_and_activities: Travelers can choose to pay chauffeur rides and activities on trip/location instead of prepaying upfront, or skip optional items.

disruption_handling_qa.prompt: What happens if marine weather disrupts scuba diving in Goa?
disruption_handling_qa.response: The Celestial Tours autonomous engine identifies high wind (>35 km/h) or heavy rainfall (>25 mm/h), flags the water activity, and offers the traveler an instant swap to the indoor Sahakari Spice Plantation Tour or Old Latin Quarter Walk, recalculating the price difference instantly.

disruption_handling_qa.prompt: Can a traveler opt out of paying for cabs and activities upfront?
disruption_handling_qa.response: Yes. Through Celestial Tours flexible checkout, travelers can check 'Pay on Visit / Spot' for chauffeur rides and select activities, only paying the base accommodation deposit online.

disruption_handling_qa.prompt: How does the system ensure travelers do not get overloaded?
disruption_handling_qa.response: The system applies strict pacing rules: Relaxed pace limits to 1-2 activities/day with late mornings; Moderate pace limits to 2-3 activities; and Packed pace schedules up to 4 activities with mandatory 45-minute transit buffers.
